name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Coastal Saunas have been designing and selling their innovative infrared saunas for over 15 years. They can now boast of eight unique designs all of which use their own Zero EMF heater, a system they have spent many years perfecting. The far infrared light that radiates from the Zero EMF heaters works in conjunction with the specialty Carbon Wave 360 panels which leave less than 20% of the infrared heat in the air.



The large amount of infrared heat generated by Coastal Saunas maximises the health and wellbeing benefits for users. After just one use the body begins to detoxify and the skin can look more radiant. After regular use in a Coastal Sauna, users can feel a reduction in a range of afflictions such as joint stiffness, general pains, asthma and eczema.



Coastal Saunas come with a number of specialist features designed to help you enjoy your infrared sauna experience even more. The doors handles are hand carved from wood and the chromotherapy lights are placed at the correct angles to reach users most effectively. The programmable timers are easy to use and the bronze tinted doors allow for a soothing and private experience.
